preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (address 0xE44d394BB296739739617497aaD26c9117A43c77)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawAllToOwner() to drain all BUSD tokens accumulated in the contract from fees. This function swaps all accumulated IMPERIAL tokens for BUSD and sends them directly to the owner's specified receiver address. No other user interaction is required beyond the owner calling this privileged function.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The ImperialToken contract has a withdrawAllToOwner() function that is only callable by the owner. This function swaps all accumulated IMPERIAL tokens (from fees) to BUSD and sends them to a specified receiver address. Since the owner is hardcoded to 0xE44d394BB296739739617497aaD26c9117A43c77, an attacker who can impersonate this address can drain all accumulated fees from the contract.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner address and call withdrawAllToOwner() with the attacker's address as the receiver to drain all accumulated BUSD tokens.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate the owner address (0xE44d394BB296739739617497aaD26c9117A43c77) using vm.prank.
2. Call withdrawAllToOwner(address(this)) on the target contract.
3. The contract will swap accumulated IMPERIAL tokens to BUSD and send them to the attacker.
4. Verify the attacker's BUSD balance increased.
